changelog: Matchable admin-defined questions feed matching (#1803): a `customField:<key>` dimension family (exact / overlap / closeness with tolerance), answers loaded in bulk for the whole pass (`src/lib/matching/customAnswers.ts`), offered in the rule editor and refused at the save unless the field is matchable in the org (`not_matchable_field`).

en: Matching rules can now weigh your own questions — for example "target industry" — just like skills or language.
tr: Eşleştirme kuralları artık kendi sorularınıza da — örneğin "hedef sektör" — beceri ya da dil gibi ağırlık verebiliyor.
de: Matching-Regeln können jetzt Ihre eigenen Fragen gewichten – etwa „Zielbranche“ – genau wie Fähigkeiten oder Sprache.
